name: Commerce Hub owner preview
description: Password-protected single-owner marketplace connection preview with PostgreSQL persistence.

APP_ORIGIN.description: Exact HTTPS origin copied from this Heroku app's Settings. No trailing slash.

OWNER_PASSWORD.description: Private owner preview password, at least 20 characters

COMMERCE_TOKEN_KEY.description: Stable encryption key: generate 32 random bytes and encode as base64.

DATABASE_URL.description: Attached PostgreSQL connection URL, supplied by the selected database add-on.

PGSSL_VERIFY.description: Verify the database TLS certificate. Configure PGSSL_CA if your provider requires a custom CA.
